items.name: Dogwood Blossom Wilmington Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: Navy tee printed on the chest with a lifelike painted flowering dogwood branch with white blooms, hanging from a dogwood branch in a Wilmington spring garden, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A relaxed garment-dyed tee printed with a lifelike painted flowering dogwood branch, white blooms and green leaves, a Wilmington NC spring favorite. Made to order.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Heavyweight 6.1 oz ring-spun cotton, pre-shrunk, double-needle stitching, no side seams
Dogwood illustration printed on the front chest, not embroidered
